text: 一个矮小的人走向伯纳德，举起一把月牙形镰刀。他的两个同伴蹲伏在旁，不停发出啼鸣。
保持沉默，继续观察，前往199。采取行动并开枪，前往135。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 133
text: One of the diminutive men now steps toward Bernard, lifting a moon-shaped sickle. His two comrades crouch and keep up a trill.
To remain silent and watch, go to 199. To take action and shoot, go to 135.
